_comment: mini-SIEM agent config for the WEF COLLECTOR. Instead of reading this machine's own Security log, it reads 'ForwardedEvents' — the channel where WEF deposits everything forwarded from the fleet. Put this on the collector, point SiemHost at your mini-SIEM, and run MiniSiemAgent.ps1. On the 200 endpoints you install NOTHING: they forward via WEF/Group Policy.
